Manufacturing of [[Polyvinyl Chloride|PVC stabilizers]] | parent = Ananthaksha Chemical Products Ltd. | website = {{URL|www.waldies.com}} }} '''Waldies Compound Limited''' (Waldies) ([[ISO]] – 9001; [[ISO]] – 14001 & [[OHSAS 18001|OHSAS – 18001 certified]]) is an Indian chemical company It is India's oldest manufacturer of [[Lead oxide red|lead oxides]].{{cite news|url=http://gillandersarbuthnot.in/chemical.php|title=Waldies Griffin Brand products conform to Indian, British & American specifications|work=Gillanders Arbuthnot}} It is headquartered in [[Kolkata, West Bengal]]. The company produces [[red lead]], [[litharge]], [[polyvinyl chloride]] (PVC) stabilizers and [[lubricants]] across [[India]]. ==History== Waldies was established in 1858 by Dr. David Waldie, a [[Scotland|Scottish]] [[chemist]] who moved to [[India]]. It has been suggested that Waldie was responsible for the original formulation of [[chloroform]].{{cite news|title=Credit due over chloroform find |url=https://www.scotsman.com/news/credit-due-over-chloroform-find-1-940223|work=[[The Scotsman]]|date=January 18, 2002}}{{cite news|title=David Waldie - From Chloroform to Calcutta|url=http://annethousemuseum.org.uk/permanent-exhibits/from-chloroform-to-calcutta|work=Annet House Museum|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190129181847/http://annethousemuseum.org.uk/permanent-exhibits/from-chloroform-to-calcutta|archive-date=29 January 2019}}{{cite news|title=The Discovery of Chloroform: Has David Waldie's Role Been Exaggerated?|url=http://anesthesiology.pubs.asahq.org/article.aspx?articleid=1930768|work=ASA Publications|date=April 2011}} Waldies were frontrunners in the development of the chemical industry in [[India]] and were the first to manufacture [[Lead oxide red|oxides of lead]] on a large scale. In November 1967, the company was incorporated under the name D. Waldie & Company (Lead Oxides) Ltd' renamed in 1968 to Waldies Limited. Previous to being purchased by Ananthaksha Chemical Products Ltd. in 2017 their parent company was [[Gillanders Arbuthnot & Co.]] ==Operations== The company produces [[red lead]], [[litharge]], [[polyvinyl chloride]] (PVC) stabilizers and [[lubricants]]. Waldies has offices in [[Rajasthan]], [[New Delhi]], [[West Bengal]] and manufacturing facilities in [[West Bengal]] and [[Odisha]].{{cite news|title=Gillanders Arbuthnot & Company's board meeting On March, 9Th 2017|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/announcements/gillanders-arbuthnotcompanys-board-meeting-on-march-9th-2017-1060841.html|work=[[Moneycontrol.com]]|date=March 1, 2017}}{{cite news|title=ACharya Prafulla Chandra Ray - ISICAL|url=https://www.isical.ac.in/~amartya/apc4reprint.pdf|work=ISICAL|page=235}} The company has been praised several times over the years for its role in the development of the industrial chemicals industry in India.{{cite news|title=Gillanders Arbuthnot & Company's board meeting On March, 9Th 2017|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/announcements/gillanders-arbuthnotcompanys-board-meeting-on-march-9th-2017-1060841.html|work=[[Moneycontrol.com]]|date=March 1, 2017}}{{cite news|title=ACharya Prafulla Chandra Ray - ISICAL|url=https://www.isical.ac.in/~amartya/apc4reprint.pdf|work=ISICAL|page=235}} Waldies is headquartered in [[Kolkata, West Bengal]].{{cite news|title=Outcome of Board Meeting|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/announcements/others/outcome-of-board-meeting/article21921494.ece|work=[[Business Line]]}} The managing director is Deepak Ojha, who succeeded D.K. Sharda of [[Gillanders Arbuthnot & Co.]] Ltd.{{cite news|last1=Menon|first1= Shailesh |title=Waldies Compound remains the only supplier of a critical component used for making glass panels in nuclear reactors|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/metals-mining/waldies-compound-remains-the-only-supplier-of-a-critical-component-used-for-making-glass-panels-in-nuclear-reactors/articleshow/65850536.cms|work=[[The Economic Times]]|date=September 20, 2018}} The company owns Griffin and Ducatus and recently launched D'Wall, a brand aimed at the construction industry.{{cite news|title=Scheme of Arrangement - Gillanders Arbuthnot & Co. Ltd.|url=https://www.cse-india.com/upload/announcement/Gillanders%20Arbuthnot%20&%20Co.-Scheme%20of%20Arrangement.pdf|work=[[Calcutta Stock Exchange]]}} ==See also== * [[Chemical industry]] * [[List of companies of India]] * [[Bengal Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals]] * [[Vivimed Labs]] * [[Pescafresh]] ==References== {{Reflist|2}} ==External links== * {{Official website|https://www.waldies.com/}} * [https://www.ducatus.in Ducatus – Lubricants & Additives] * [https://www.dwall.co.in DWALL – Paints & Emulsions] {{Portal bar|Companies|India}} [[Category:1858 establishments in India]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies established in 1858]] [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Kolkata]] [[Category:Chemical companies of India]] [[Category:Specialty chemical companies]] {{india-company-stub}}

Waldies Compound Limited (Waldies) (ISO – 9001; ISO – 14001 & OHSAS – 18001 certified) is an Indian chemical company It is India's oldest manufacturer of lead oxides. It is headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal.
The company produces red lead, litharge, polyvinyl chloride (PVC) stabilizers and lubricants across India.
